versions.subject: cisco secure firewall detections - third batch
versions.detection:
`cisco_secure_firewall` EventType=IntrusionEvent earliest=-7d
| stats dc(_time) as TriggerCount min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime 
        values(IntrusionRuleMessage) as IntrusionRuleMessages 
        by SignatureID Classification MitreAttackGroups InlineResult InlineResultReason
| where TriggerCount = 1
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
| `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
| `cisco_secure_firewall___rare_snort_rule_triggered_filter`
